_noteP: Mana Barrier (ManaBarrierIconAbility) carries zero mSpellCalculations -- a self-shield triggered at low HP, not damage. P carries no hits.
_noteQ: Rocket Grab: TotalDamage = NamedDataValue(BaseDamage) + StatByNamedDataValue(no mStat field -> AP default per FormulaInterpreter's 'part.Stat ?? 0', mDataValue=APRatio=1.2) = wiki's 'Magic Damage: 110/160/210/260/310 (+120% AP)' exactly (BaseDamage DataValues rank1-5 = 110/160/210/260/310).
_noteW: Overdrive grants attack speed + a decaying movement speed burst, then self-slows -- zero damage anywhere in the BIN. Its only calc ('{c01903c1}', a ByCharLevelBreakpoints level-scaling term) is unrelated to the orphaned 'PercentHealthDamage' DataValue (0.01 constant, referenced by NO calc in this spell object -- vestigial/unused, not wired to any GameCalculation) and matches no damage line on the live wiki tooltip either. W carries no hits.
_noteE: Power Fist: empowers the next basic attack to deal double damage and knock up. TotalDamage = StatByCoefficient(mStat=2 TOTAL AD, no mStatFormula, coefficient 2.0) + StatByCoefficient(no mStat -> AP default, coefficient 0.25) -- the 2.0x total-AD coefficient matches Riot's own 'next basic attack deal DOUBLE damage' framing (the attack's normal 100% AD plus a 100% bonus = 200% total AD in one combined number), consistent with the detailed tooltip's separately-stated '100% AD (+25% AP) BONUS physical damage' being just the incremental half of this same combined total. Modeled as the single self-contained empowered-attack hit (TotalDamage, count 1) since Power Fist consumes/replaces that one attack rather than adding to an independently-tracked auto, matching how the auto-picker (and this project's convention of using the BIN's own named 'TotalDamage' output) already treated it. A second BIN calc ('{a9d6b924}', StatByCoefficient(mStat=2,1.75)+StatByCoefficient(no mStat,1.25)) exists but is not referenced by the wiki's documented Power Fist numbers at all -- left unidentified and unused rather than guessed at.
_noteR: Static Field has two independent BIN-verified magic-damage components confirmed against the live wiki tooltip previews. (1) Active cast (AOE burst to all nearby enemies, destroys shields + silences): ActiveDamage = NamedDataValue(ActiveBaseDamage) + StatByNamedDataValue(no mStat -> AP default, ActiveAPRatio=1.0) = 'Magic Damage: 275/400/525 (+100% AP)' exactly (ActiveBaseDamage DataValues rank1-3 = 275/400/525; R has only 3 ranks) -- modeled as R's direct hit. (2) Passive on-hit stack-detonation proc (fires whenever R is off cooldown; a basic attack applies a stack, and an afflicted stack detonates every 1s dealing damage): PassiveDamage = NamedDataValue(PassiveBaseDamage) + StatByNamedDataValue(no mStat -> AP default, PassiveAPRatio) + AbilityResourceByCoefficient(0.02 x caster max mana) = 'Magic Damage: 50/100/150 (+30/40/50% AP) (+2% maximum mana)' exactly (PassiveBaseDamage DataValues rank1-3 = 50/100/150) -- modeled as an onHit bonusEffect, same pattern as Tristana E's main-hit-plus-onHit-bonus-effect precedent.
